name: Black-Scholes Option Calculator
meta_title: Black-Scholes Option Calculator: Call, Put Prices and Greeks
meta_description: Price European call and put options with the Black-Scholes model, including dividend yield, and see delta, gamma, theta, vega and rho.
subtitle: Work out the theoretical value of a European call and put from the stock price, strike, time to expiration, volatility, interest rate and dividend yield, along with the option Greeks.

Prices are per share; a standard US equity option contract covers 100 shares. The model assumes European exercise and constant volatility, interest rate and dividend yield, so it is a theoretical value, not a market quote. American options can be worth more than these values when early exercise pays off.
